long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Helsinki in 1950, Christian Johansson grew up with Åland family ties and stories of seafaring. He became an architect, but traditional ships developed into a parallel working life. By the late twentieth century he was skippering youth voyages on a restored ketch, combining vessel stewardship with practical training at sea.

Through a Finnish operating company, Johansson acquired a larger historic schooner and brought it to Helsinki for Baltic and North Sea charter work. The vessel joined successive Tall Ships' Races before its sale. Away from the waterfront, a Helsinki architecture office bearing his and his wife's names remained active in hospitality interiors.
